title: 会前说宽松：会后转偏紧，增长会被拖住吗
speaker: E. Catarina Bego

segments.en: Real rates are also moving up. Does that mean, is that a vote of confidence for equity markets because growth is actually quite resilient? Yeah.
segments.zh: 实际利率也在上行，这是否意味着对权益市场投下信心票，因为增长其实相当有韧性？是的。

segments.en: The market, the equity market, as you can see, the rates in the reaction, at the current high, with the 25 basis points, markets can easily digest that.
segments.zh: 权益市场可以看到，在当前高位、25个基点的调整下，市场可以轻松消化。

segments.en: But if you look coming into the meeting, and you've seen Chairman Worsh saying that financial conditions are deemed easy when coming into this meeting, now if you look at the financial conditions, pause the meeting, those are now restrictive by different parameters.
segments.zh: 但会前主席曾表示金融条件偏宽松，而会后看，按不同指标衡量，金融条件已转向偏紧。

segments.en: If you look at it, no, they're not significantly restrictive. If you look at the average of financial conditions, they're on 125, and this is kind of the goldmonds, financial condition, innings. They landed about 117, and after the meeting.
segments.zh: 它们并非显著收紧。金融条件均值在125，高盛金融条件指数会后落在117附近。

segments.en: So what does it mean? It's starting to get restrictive, right? So it's not in a situation where it's going to trip the growth that is existing in the economy.
segments.zh: 这意味着什么？开始偏紧，但还不至于拖累当前经济中的增长。

segments.en: And again, not to forget that this is a moderate hiking cycle, it's not a full on hiking cycle. What, at least the indications, words are such.
segments.zh: 别忘了这是温和的加息周期，而非全面加息周期，至少信号和措辞是这样。

segments.en: If we were to go on a full-mod hiking cycle, certainly that is going to be a lot more challenging because the financial conditions are going to tighten further. And I think this is the catalyst to where the growth is going to go, is where the financial conditions are going to go into the last part of the year.
segments.zh: 若进入全面加息周期，挑战会大得多，因为金融条件会进一步收紧。增长走向，取决于下半年金融条件如何演变。
